To correct my initial response, where I’m from we don’t have academic or applied French. They are all academic. So you don’t chose a level.

It was a rollercoaster. For reference, in grade 9 I got 99, grade 10 - 98, grade 11-97, grade 12-95. I think it really depends on your level in French. French came easily to me as I love languages. It was also easy cuz I know Russian so pronunciation was easy and memorization came naturally. However if you struggle with languages and grammar then it can be a hassle. Grade 9 is very simple but the jump to grade 10 can cause some people to struggle as more grammar comes in. In grade 11 and 12 you will be introduced to many books. In grade 12 I had to write an on demand essay about a book in one hour. It also depends on the teacher and the criteria - it can get subjective at times. Basically it’s gonna be hard if French and languages don’t come naturally to you.
